title: seed_manifest

seed_manifest_id.description: Unique kebab-case identifier for this seed manifest instance.

version.description: Semantic version of the seed manifest format.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this seed manifest was initially created.

last_updated.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this seed manifest was last modified.

global_seed_order.description: Ordered array of seed IDs defining the default ingestion sequence across all pipeline steps.

level_id.description: Kebab-case identifier for this nesting level (e.g., foundation, domain, detail).

description.description: Human-readable description of what seeds at this level provide.

seed_ids.description: Ordered array of seed IDs belonging to this nesting level.

items.description: A nesting level defining a group of seeds at a specific hierarchy tier.

nested_order.description: Hierarchical ordering of seeds into named levels for multi-tier ingestion.

seed_id.description: Unique kebab-case identifier for this seed document.

path.description: File path to the seed document relative to the repository root.

description.description: Human-readable summary of what this seed document contains.

required.description: Whether this seed document must be present for pipeline execution.

source_type.description: Category of the seed source: doc (documentation), spec (specification), config (configuration), or other.

items.description: A seed document definition with path, source type, and required flag.

seeds.description: Array of seed document definitions, each describing a source document available for ingestion.

^(\\d{2}[a-z]?)$.description: Array of seed IDs required for this pipeline step.

step_requirements.description: Map from pipeline step numbers to arrays of seed IDs required for that step.

readme_required.description: Whether README files are required in scoped directories.

root_readme_required.description: Whether a root-level README file is required in the repository.

readme_depth_default.description: Default directory depth at which README requirements apply (0 = root only).

^.+/$.description: README depth override for this directory scope (0 = root only).

readme_depth_by_scope.description: Per-scope overrides for README depth requirements, keyed by directory path suffix.

scope.description: Array of directory paths that are in scope for documentation coverage checks.

exclusions.description: Array of directory paths or patterns excluded from documentation coverage checks.

doc_paths.description: Array of paths where documentation files are expected to be found.

docs_policy.description: Policy configuration for documentation coverage enforcement (README requirements, scoping, exclusions).

description: Schema for the seed manifest defining seed documents, their ordering, step requirements, and documentation policy.
